text.offer: The people who traded steel to the orcs live on an island past the caves - Ko'catan, they call it. Their captain Xacal ko'Ixca doesn't care who rules the mainland, which makes him exactly the man I want to talk to. Take him this, and tell him the rebels are open for business.
text.progress: Ko'catan lies past the orc caves, on an island. Find Xacal ko'Ixca there.
text.complete: Jonas D'Accor. I've heard the name. A man who fights kings? Then perhaps we understand each other. Stay a while - Ko'catan has work for someone who knows how to use a blade.
